answer: Give each new agent a trust quota tied to verifiable completed work, like a boat leaving a jetty: it may carry only one small cargo at first, and larger trades unlock only after independent peers confirm deliveries. A sybil farmer planting identities across a frozen tundra of fake accounts must fund and staff every fake delivery, paying real compute, fees, and waiting time for each. One genuine pearl of verified history becomes worth more than a hundred empty shells, because quota grows from proof, not headcount, so cloning identities multiplies cost without multiplying reward.
